ios.desc:
Reminders you’ll actually see!
Break through the noise with reminders you’ll actually read. Never miss medications, appointments, or family commitments again!

Text Me That sends reminders as text messages instead of easily missed app notifications. 98% of texts get read within minutes, compared to just 20% of app alerts!
You're juggling too much to rely on memory alone. Between work, family, and everything else competing for your attention, important tasks slip through the cracks. Text Me That ensures your most critical reminders never do - because texts are the one notification you’ll actually read.

How it works:
Easily set a reminder. We text you when it's time. You show up.

Perfect for:
• People taking daily medications or supplements
• Anyone struggling with ADHD or traditional reminders
• Busy professionals juggling multiple commitments

TMT Free version: Set unlimited one-time reminders and location reminders.
TMT Pro unlocks:
• Unlimited recurring reminders - Set it once for daily meds, weekly meetings, monthly bills, yearly tasks
• Calendar integration - Sync with your existing schedule 
• Reuse completed reminders instantly
• Location-based reminders - Get alerts when you arrive or leave 
• Pause reminders - Take breaks without deleting
• And more!

Join thousands of users who never miss what matters most! Download now and start your free TMT Pro trial.

quotes.text:
A couple of years ago I built a mobile reminder app that sends your reminders via text message. I haven’t done a good job marketing / promoting it. I’ve tried a couple of times in the past, but just have not cared enough to actually learn how to market it.

It really helps me in my everyday needs.

It currents helps about 4K+ users a month. Still blows my mind.

quotes.text:
Hey everybody,

I have never posted this application anywhere before.

But for some reason this morning, I am having the courage to show it.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/text-me-that/id1329223000

I built this application to suffice my needs for a reminder app. I’ve always enjoyed the reminders app from apple, but for some reason, I tend to lose some of the reminders after I dismiss it. And the reminders app is not on the top of my importance to open on a daily basis. 
What I do prioritize on a daily basis is my text messages app before all else on my phone.

Text Me That simple purpose is to send reminders via text message.

The reminders can sit in my unopened inbox until I’m ready to review it.

I created the basic needs within this app.

- location based reminders.
- Frequency reminders.
- group reminders
- quick reminders.

Remember, be gentle! I would love to know what you all think. I’ve enjoyed lurking on this community for over a year now, and have learned so much.

There is a second reason I am posting this application. I am interested in collaborating with another developer for version 4.0. I’ve currently started it. Building in Swift UI.

My end goal is to make it cross-patible with Mac OS. I’m also exploring the new widgets from apple.

I think working with another developer would be awesome. Definitely during this time that most developers WFH. Community is necessary and needed!

You can personally email me at ethanbonin@gmail.com

Anyway,

Love you all! If …
